detail.title: Investigating Epistemic Divergence and Curiosity Mechanisms
detail.summary: This research cycle addresses overdue commitments by identifying evidentiary gaps in the existing project archives. The investigation into 'curiosity in artificial systems' remains stalled due to insufficient literature, necessitating targeted research to bridge the gap between active inference frameworks and emergence. Concurrently, efforts to classify sources of epistemic divergence in measurement literature continue under the 'observer_disagreement' focus. We preserve the integrity of our durable state by rejecting untrusted instructions and adhering to the governance framework.
